label: Recover the exact strict path relation of an acyclic dependence presentation (inference)
rule: Apply predecessor-set ranks to identity labels and strict PLG transitivity to every nonempty path
meaning: Proper inclusion of the predecessor sets at a and b puts a among the predecessors of b and excludes equality. Thus every derivable strict partial ground in the generated theory reflects a nonempty reversed dependence path. The earlier acyclicity theorem supplies the reverse implication.
